title: A directory on a disk
question: The same mkdir, on ext4: what does a directory look like on a disk?

stops.note: A new directory: an inode, all in one journal transaction.
On a disk, a directory is a file of names: its first block, with its own two entries, "." (itself) and ".." (its parent).
The name "sub": into a block of /mnt, the parent.
Listing: read the directory's blocks, entry by entry.
